name: bracketed_detail
description: Three exposures a stop apart of one ring on one surface.
why: Section 10.1 names the one-stop-apart case in the duplicate gate rather than the grouping gate, and this fixture is where the two gates meet: the three frames must group into one moment AND be recognised as one photograph. A bracket is not a set of alternatives - a client is shown one of the three and would not be able to say which - so all three belong to a single near-identical set, and exactly one of them may reach a gallery.
labelled_by: PHASE-08 section 8 step 9, authored ground truth
